# Phase Two — Gevurah Critique

The Awtsmoos cuts through convenient paint that would leave old machinery below;
Awtsmoos.com becomes stronger when the live contract is preserved while hidden complexity has nowhere to grow.

## Twenty improvements

1. Do not delete the historical `ensureTrackStyles` export if callers outside the traced path may still import it.
2. Make the compatibility style initializer inert and document static ownership.
3. Keep `renderTracks` signature unchanged.
4. Keep `renderTrackRow` signature unchanged for any direct consumers.
5. Keep `createCommandButton` and `durationPill` exports unchanged.
6. Keep selection exports unchanged.
7. Keep cache API unchanged.
8. Avoid reusing search `.premium-track-row` rules for browser tracks unless selectors intentionally overlap.
9. Scope track-browser CSS to `#list-tracks` and `.premium-event-toolbar` where practical.
10. Keep toolbar copy wrapping and `min-width:0` so long event titles cannot widen the page.
11. Keep command decks gridable at 720px and narrower.
12. Make 44px the minimum command/checkbox/main-title hit area.
13. Use safe DOM for all title/cache/selection text.
14. Do not animate width/height; use transform, border, background, box-shadow, opacity.
15. Add reduced-motion only to this subsystem rather than global animation suppression.
16. Preserve cache `saved` visual state.
17. Preserve selected count updates and disabled Add truth.
18. Preserve event one-file Download vs multi-file ZIP wording.
19. Verify no runtime style element ID remains necessary after migration.
20. Run all seven existing Rebbe tests plus new track contracts after code is complete.
